identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase I Study of Administrating CD19 Chimeric Antigen Receptor Expressing T Cells Followed by Allogeneic Stem Cell Transplantation in Patients With Refractory CD19+ B-linage Leukemia/Lymphoma

descriptionModule.detailedDescription:
Primary objectives

1. To determine the safety and feasibility of allogeneic stem cell transplantation combined with adoptive transfer of T cells modified to express CD19-specific chimeric antigen receptor (CD19CAR) for treatment of leukemia and lymphoma Secondary objectives
2. To measure the efficacy of the CD19CAR T cell infusion combined with allogeneic stem cell transplantation

conditions: Adult Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia in Remission

primaryOutcomes.measure: Safety - incidence of adverse events defined as dose-limited toxicity
primaryOutcomes.description: incidence of adverse events defined as dose-limited toxicity
